## Objective
- Build a complete, playable top-down Vietnam War wave shooter ("NAM '68 — Operation Iron Triangle") per the original request: overhead shooter with 100+ period-accurate weapons, boss battles every 10 rounds, fully customizable character with loadout screen for weapons and armor.
- Iteratively extended by the user across multiple follow-up requests (squad system, store economy, biomes, three-screen menu, animated forest menu background, money chip).

## Requirements
- Top-down shooter, Vietnam War themed, 100+ period-accurate weapons (116 implemented: pistols, snipers, MGs, SMGs, rifles, battle rifles, etc.).
- Boss battle every 10 rounds (4 rotating bosses in `BOSSES`).
- Fully customizable character (barracks screen).
- Store to buy weapons/armor with money earned per round; difficulty and money ramp slightly each round.
- Slots for main weapon and secondary weapon (PRIMARY [1] / SIDEARM [2]) plus armor slot.
- Character clothing customizable with period-accurate options (fatigues, boots, armor, headwear, face paint).
- Squadmates NOT robots — real soldiers of various ranks (Private → Colonel) and Vietnam-era classes/nationalities (US, ARVN, ROK Marines, Australian).
- Squad: max 3 march-out slots; 5 tiers × 10 soldiers each (rarity: Common → War Grade); traits + attacks; each squadmate buffs the player.
- Squadmates acquired via separate "Reinforcement Office" with 3 price ranges; each package grants 1 gear item + 2 soldier transfers (tier-weighted).
- Each level round rotates through 4 areas/biomes: Vietnamese village, rice paddies, dense jungle, open field.
- Main screen tabs separated: Loadout, S-4 Store, Squad (separate screens from title).
- Main menu background: Vietnam forest with a Huey helicopter flying and an M60 door gunner firing.
- Requisition (money) chip visible top-right of every screen; player starts with $80.

## Decisions
- Single-page vanilla JS game: `index.html` + `js/data.js` (data) + `js/game.js` (engine/UI). No build steps.
- Weapon rarity tiers computed by price quintiles; armor/cloth/boot tiers mapped by index.
- Save persistence via `localStorage` key `nam68_v3` (`S` profile object; `save()` updates on every economy change).
- Paddy water zones shared between ground paint and slow logic via `paddyZones()` (contains player, squad, and enemy movement).
- Round flow: `roundClear()` → `scr-inter` (Loadout/Squad/Store buttons) → `nextRound()`; death → `scr-over` with gear/requisition kept.
- Menu backdrop is canvas-drawn: `drawMenuScene()` + `treeLayer()` + `palmTree()` + `drawHuey(t)` (Huey sweeps sky sinusoidally, rotor blur, M60 door gunner bursts with tracers/dirt puffs/muzzle flash/brass).

## NAM '68 — Operation Iron Triangle

A top-down Vietnam War wave shooter. No build steps — open `index.html` and play.

### Screens
- **Main menu** — animated Vietnam forest backdrop with a Huey flying a door-gunner M60 pass; **▶ Start Mission** launches round 1 immediately.
- **Barracks** ("Report for Duty") — name, skin, headwear, face camo, fatigues, boots, body armor.
- **Loadout** — assign owned weapons to PRIMARY [1] / SIDEARM [2] slots and pick worn armor.
- **S-4 Store** — 116 period weapons by class, armor and era clothing; purchases equippable in the Loadout screen.
- **Squad** — roster of human soldiers (US / ARVN / ROK Marines / Australian SAS) across 5 rank tiers (Private → Colonel); the Reinforcement Office processes transfer packages (1 gear item + 2 soldier transfers). 3 march-out slots; each soldier buffs your stats and fights beside you with a specialty trait (Belt-Fed Gunner, Tunnel Rat, Medic, Grenadier, RTO spotter…).
- Persistent **REQUISITION** ($ — starts at $80) chip shown top-right on every screen.

### Gameplay
- WASD move · mouse aim/click fire · R reload · 1/2 swap weapon · G grenade · Shift sprint · Esc pause.
- 4 rotating areas per round: village → rice paddies (water slows you — use the dikes) → dense jungle → open field.
- Boss battle every 10th round (4 rotating bosses, escalating by cycle).
- Difficulty, enemies and money rewards ramp each round; deaths keep gear, roster and requisition.

### Tech
- `index.html` + `js/data.js` (content data) + `js/game.js` (engine/UI). Vanilla JS + Canvas, WebAudio synth SFX, `localStorage` saves.
- Headless screenshot smoke test: `node test/shots.mjs /tmp/opencode` (needs `playwright-core` + Chromium).
